description: JavaScript code for managing order shipping information UI interactions, including form validation, toggling display of form elements, and handling user actions like editing and viewing shipping details.

methods.name: showEdit
methods.description: Toggles visibility of edit and display elements for shipping info based on user action.

methods.name: restoreEditField
methods.description: Restores the original values in edit fields for shipping info.

methods.name: showShipByDate
methods.description: Shows or hides the shipping date input based on user selection.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Toggles between view and edit modes for shipping information display.
